title: Alpha tuning: closer air camera and dark edge blur
summary: changes from the user's feedback on the Alpha hype effects (PR #174). The Big-air camera now closes in behind the rider instead of pulling back, so the flight feels personal. A new Air dark blur replaces the Apex sun glare, which looked washed out: the edges darken, desaturate and blur toward the centre in big air, and clear on touchdown. The air effects now need a real launch (at least 4 ft above takeoff, 12 ft or more above the ground, about half a second airborne; slow-mo needs an apex at least 14 ft up and 8 ft above takeoff), so rolling off the side of a hill no longer triggers them.
details: new unit tests for a hillside drop (nothing fires) and a medium kicker (no slow-mo); the content browser test passes on Caribou Peak and Sonora Dunes.
limitation: tuning is still first-pass pending user feedback; audio not listened to; physical phones untested; this is host-verified, not yet a verified public release.
